test_cases.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuild on a valid carry_patch workspace enqueues a rebuild job with correct key, group_key, and strategy captured at enqueue time, returning HTTP 202 with the queued job record.
preconditions: SQLite database has a workspace record with mode='carry_patch', status='active', clone_status='ready'
Workspace has at least one patch with status='active'
REBUILD_STRATEGY workspace variable is set to 'rebase'
Caller has 'rebuilds:write' permission scope
No existing rebuild job is queued or running for this workspace
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuild'); assert resp.status == 202; assert resp.body.status == 'queued'; assert resp.body.type == 'rebuild'; assert resp.body.key == 'my-workspace'; assert resp.body.group_key == 'my-workspace:' + integration_branch; assert resp.body.payload.strategy == 'rebase'

test_cases.description: Rebuild job executor fetches from upstream, applies all active/conflict patches in position order, force-updates the integration branch, updates integration_head_sha, deletes the temporary branch, removes merged_upstream patches, and compacts positions on success.
preconditions: SQLite database has a carry_patch workspace with integration_branch='integration'
Patches table has 2 active patches at positions 1 and 2, and 1 merged_upstream patch at position 3
Upstream remote is reachable and resolveUpstreamAuth returns valid credentials
Git repository exists at WORKSPACE_ROOT/<slug>
REBUILD_STRATEGY captured in job payload is 'rebase'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: executeJob(rebuildJob); job = getJobByID(jobID); assert job.status == 'completed'; result = parseJobResult(job); assert result.patches_applied == 2; assert result.patches_skipped == 1; assert result.patches_removed == 1; assert result.integration_head_sha != null; ws = getWorkspace('my-workspace'); assert ws.integration_head_sha == result.integration_head_sha; patches = listPatches('my-workspace'); assert len(patches) == 2; assert patches[0].position == 1; assert patches[1].position == 2; assert tempBranchExists(repoPath) == false

test_cases.description: With REBUILD_STRATEGY='rebase', the executor identifies unique commits via 'git log --reverse --format=%H <upstream_head>..<patch_branch>' and cherry-picks each commit onto the temporary branch, preserving original patch branch refs.
preconditions: Git repository has a patch branch 'feature/foo' with 2 commits not present in upstream HEAD
Temporary branch is checked out at upstream HEAD
REBUILD_STRATEGY in job payload is 'rebase'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: spy = instrumentGitRunner(); applyPatchRebase(repoPath, upstreamHead, 'feature/foo'); assert spy.logCalls[0].args contains '--reverse --format=%H ' + upstreamHead + '..feature/foo'; assert len(spy.cherryPickCalls) == 2; originalRef = getRef(repoPath, 'feature/foo'); assert originalRef == preTestRef; result = getPatchResult('feature/foo'); assert result.status == 'success'; assert result.new_head_sha != null

test_cases.description: With REBUILD_STRATEGY='merge', the executor merges each patch branch into the temporary branch with --no-ff, producing a merge commit, and records the merge commit SHA in patch_results.
preconditions: Git repository has a patch branch 'feature/bar' with commits not in upstream HEAD
Temporary branch is checked out at upstream HEAD
REBUILD_STRATEGY in job payload is 'merge'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: spy = instrumentGitRunner(); applyPatchMerge(repoPath, 'feature/bar'); assert spy.mergeNoFFCalls[0].branch == 'feature/bar'; headAfter = getHEAD(repoPath); assert isMergeCommit(headAfter) == true; result = getPatchResult('feature/bar'); assert result.status == 'success'; assert result.new_head_sha == headAfter

test_cases.description: When a cherry-pick produces a conflict that rerere cannot fully resolve, the executor aborts, sets the patch status to 'conflict' in the database, records conflict_files, deletes the temporary branch, and halts the rebuild without updating the integration branch.
preconditions: Git repository has a patch branch 'feature/conflict' whose cherry-pick produces a conflict
rerere has no recorded resolution for this conflict
'git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U' returns ['src/main.go']
Temporary branch exists at upstream HEAD
Integration branch exists at a prior SHA
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: priorIntegrationSHA = getRef(repoPath, 'integration'); executeJob(rebuildJob); job = getJobByID(jobID); assert job.status == 'failed'; patch = getPatch('feature/conflict'); assert patch.status == 'conflict'; assert patch.conflict_files == ['src/main.go']; assert getRef(repoPath, 'integration') == priorIntegrationSHA; assert tempBranchExists(repoPath) == false; result = parseJobResult(job); assert result.patch_results[0].status == 'conflict'; assert result.patch_results[0].conflict_files == ['src/main.go']

test_cases.description: When a patch's branch does not exist in the repository during rebuild, the executor skips it with status 'skipped' and null new_head_sha in patch_results, and continues to the next patch without halting.
preconditions: Patches table has two active patches: 'feature/exists' (branch exists in repo) and 'feature/missing' (branch does not exist in repo)
Patches are at positions 1 and 2 respectively
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: executeJob(rebuildJob); result = parseJobResult(getJobByID(jobID)); assert result.patch_results[0].branch_name == 'feature/exists'; assert result.patch_results[0].status == 'success'; assert result.patch_results[1].branch_name == 'feature/missing'; assert result.patch_results[1].status == 'skipped'; assert result.patch_results[1].new_head_sha == null; assert result.patches_skipped == 1

test_cases.description: Patches with status 'merged_upstream' or 'disabled' are reported as 'skipped' in patch_results without any attempt to apply them.
preconditions: Patches table has one patch with status='merged_upstream' and one with status='disabled'
No active or conflict patches exist
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: spy = instrumentGitRunner(); executeJob(rebuildJob); result = parseJobResult(getJobByID(jobID)); for each pr in result.patch_results: assert pr.status == 'skipped'; assert pr.new_head_sha == null; assert len(spy.cherryPickCalls) == 0; assert len(spy.mergeNoFFCalls) == 0

test_cases.description: The rebuild job is registered as type 'rebuild' in the durable_job_queue, is marked as permanently failed (non-retryable) on conflict, and is retryable on transient failures such as network errors.
preconditions: Durable job queue is initialized with SQLite backend
Rebuild job type is registered
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: assert jobTypeRegistry.has('rebuild') == true; conflictJob = simulateJobWithError(CherryPickConflictError); assert conflictJob.retryable == false; assert conflictJob.status == 'failed'; transientJob = simulateJobWithError(NetworkError); assert transientJob.retryable == true

test_cases.description: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuilds returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of rebuild job records ordered by creation time descending.
preconditions: SQLite database has a workspace 'my-workspace' with 3 rebuild jobs at different created_at timestamps
Caller has 'rebuilds:read' permission scope
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = GET('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuilds'); assert resp.status == 200; jobs = resp.body.jobs; assert len(jobs) == 3; assert jobs[0].created_at >= jobs[1].created_at; assert jobs[1].created_at >= jobs[2].created_at; for job in jobs: assert job.id != null; assert job.status in ['queued','running','completed','failed']

test_cases.description: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuilds/:id returns HTTP 200 with the full job record including patch_results payload for a completed job.
preconditions: SQLite database has a completed rebuild job with id='job-uuid-1' belonging to workspace 'my-workspace'
Job result payload contains patch_results array
Caller has 'rebuilds:read' permission scope
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = GET('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuilds/job-uuid-1'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.id == 'job-uuid-1'; assert resp.body.status == 'completed'; assert resp.body.patch_results != null; assert len(resp.body.patch_results) > 0

test_cases.description: When a cherry-pick produces a conflict and rerere has a recorded resolution, rerere auto-stages the resolved files, 'git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U' returns empty, and the rebuild continues to the next patch recording the resolved patch as 'success'.
preconditions: Git repository has rerere.enabled=true and rerere.autoupdate=true in repo config
rr-cache has a recorded resolution for the conflict in 'feature/foo'
Cherry-pick of 'feature/foo' produces a conflict that rerere can resolve
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: spy = instrumentGitRunner(); executeJob(rebuildJob); result = parseJobResult(getJobByID(jobID)); patchResult = findPatchResult(result, 'feature/foo'); assert patchResult.status == 'success'; assert patchResult.conflict_files == []; assert spy.diffUnresolvedCalls[0].output == ''; assert job.status == 'completed'

test_cases.description: When rerere cannot resolve all conflicts (unresolved conflict markers remain after rerere runs), the executor aborts the cherry-pick, sets patch status to 'conflict', records conflict_files, deletes the temporary branch, and halts the rebuild.
preconditions: Git repository has rerere.enabled=true and rerere.autoupdate=true
rr-cache has no resolution for the conflict in 'feature/conflict'
'git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U' returns ['pkg/api.go'] after rerere runs
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: priorSHA = getRef(repoPath, 'integration'); executeJob(rebuildJob); job = getJobByID(jobID); assert job.status == 'failed'; patch = getPatch('feature/conflict'); assert patch.status == 'conflict'; assert patch.conflict_files == ['pkg/api.go']; assert getRef(repoPath, 'integration') == priorSHA; assert tempBranchExists(repoPath) == false

test_cases.description: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rerere reads the rr-cache directory, enumerates subdirectories, derives path from preimage/postimage files, and returns HTTP 200 with the resolutions list including recorded_at timestamps.
preconditions: Workspace git repository exists at WORKSPACE_ROOT/my-workspace
.git/rr-cache/ contains two subdirectories, each with a preimage file
Caller has 'workspaces:read' permission scope
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = GET('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.resolutions != null; assert len(resp.body.resolutions) == 2; for r in resp.body.resolutions: assert r.path != null; assert r.path != ''

test_cases.description: DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rerere/*pathspec executes 'git rerere forget <pathspec>' via GitRunner and returns HTTP 204 on success; returns HTTP 404 if the pathspec has no recorded resolution.
preconditions: Workspace git repository exists at WORKSPACE_ROOT/my-workspace
.git/rr-cache/ has a recorded resolution for 'src/config.go'
Caller has 'workspaces:read' permission scope
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: spy = instrumentGitRunner(); resp = DELETE('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere/src/config.go'); assert resp.status == 204; assert spy.rerereForgotCalls[0].pathspec == 'src/config.go'; resp404 = DELETE('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere/nonexistent.go'); assert resp404.status == 404

test_cases.description: Sync on a carry_patch workspace resolves upstream credentials, fetches from the 'upstream' remote, advances the upstream_tracking_ref, checks each active patch for upstream merge via IsAncestor, and returns a sync response with patches_merged and rebuild_triggered fields.
preconditions: Workspace is in carry_patch mode with upstream_url configured
resolveUpstreamAuth returns valid credentials
Upstream remote is reachable
Patches table has 2 active patches
AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC is 'true'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: spy = instrumentGitRunner(); resp = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync'); assert resp.status == 200; assert 'patches_merged' in resp.body; assert 'rebuild_triggered' in resp.body; assert len(spy.isAncestorCalls) == 2; ws = getWorkspace('my-workspace'); assert ws.upstream_head_sha != null

test_cases.description: When IsAncestor returns true for a patch branch HEAD against the new upstream HEAD, the sync handler transitions that patch to 'merged_upstream' in the database and includes its branch name in patches_merged.
preconditions: Workspace is in carry_patch mode
Patches table has an active patch 'feature/already-merged' whose branch HEAD is an ancestor of the new upstream HEAD
IsAncestor returns true for 'feature/already-merged'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync'); assert resp.status == 200; assert 'feature/already-merged' in resp.body.patches_merged; patch = getPatch('feature/already-merged'); assert patch.status == 'merged_upstream'

test_cases.description: After sync completes with at least one patch merged upstream and AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC='true', a rebuild job is enqueued and rebuild_triggered=true; if a rebuild is already queued, rebuild_triggered=false.
preconditions: Workspace is in carry_patch mode
AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC workspace variable is 'true'
Sync detects one patch as merged_upstream
No existing rebuild job is queued (first scenario); an existing rebuild job is queued (second scenario)
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp1 = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync'); assert resp1.body.rebuild_triggered == true; jobsBefore = listJobs('my-workspace'); assert len(jobsBefore) == 1; resp2 = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync'); assert resp2.body.rebuild_triggered == false; jobsAfter = listJobs('my-workspace'); assert len(jobsAfter) == 1

test_cases.description: When AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC is 'false', no rebuild job is enqueued after sync regardless of merged patches or upstream ref advancement, and rebuild_triggered=false.
preconditions: Workspace is in carry_patch mode
AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC workspace variable is 'false'
Sync detects one patch as merged_upstream and upstream ref advances
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: jobsBefore = listJobs('my-workspace'); resp = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.rebuild_triggered == false; jobsAfter = listJobs('my-workspace'); assert len(jobsAfter) == len(jobsBefore)

test_cases.description: GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patch-status returns HTTP 200 with a fully aggregated response including workspace metadata, last_rebuild, patches array with last_rebuild_result and rerere_resolution_count, and summary counts.
preconditions: Workspace is in carry_patch mode with upstream_url, upstream_head_sha, integration_branch, integration_head_sha, and last_sync_at set
Patches table has 3 patches: 2 active, 1 conflict
One completed rebuild job exists with patch_results
rr-cache has 1 resolution relevant to the conflict patch
Caller has 'workspaces:read' permission scope
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = GET('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/patch-status'); assert resp.status == 200; b = resp.body; assert b.workspace_slug == 'my-workspace'; assert b.workspace_mode == 'carry_patch'; assert b.upstream_url != null; assert b.last_rebuild != null; assert len(b.patches) == 3; assert b.summary.total_patches == 3; assert b.summary.active == 2; assert b.summary.conflict == 1

test_cases.description: The summary object in the patch-status response has counts that are accurate and consistent with the patches array: total_patches equals len(patches) and the sum of status counts equals total_patches.
preconditions: Workspace is in carry_patch mode
Patches table has 5 patches: 2 active, 1 merged_upstream, 1 conflict, 1 disabled
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = GET('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/patch-status'); s = resp.body.summary; assert s.total_patches == len(resp.body.patches); assert s.active + s.merged_upstream + s.conflict + s.disabled == s.total_patches; assert s.total_patches == 5; assert s.active == 2; assert s.merged_upstream == 1; assert s.conflict == 1; assert s.disabled == 1

test_cases.description: When no rebuild has been attempted for the workspace, patch-status returns last_rebuild=null and all patch last_rebuild_result fields as null.
preconditions: Workspace is in carry_patch mode
No rebuild jobs exist for this workspace
Patches table has 2 active patches
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: resp = GET('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/patch-status'); assert resp.status == 200; assert resp.body.last_rebuild == null; for patch in resp.body.patches: assert patch.last_rebuild_result == null

test_cases.description: 'afc rebuild submit <workspace-slug>' sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuild, prints the job id and status 'queued' to stdout, and exits with code 0.
preconditions: afc CLI is configured with a valid API endpoint and PAT
Workspace 'my-workspace' is in carry_patch mode with active patches
No existing rebuild job is queued
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result = runCLI('afc rebuild submit my-workspace'); assert result.exit_code == 0; assert 'queued' in result.stdout; assert result.stderr == ''

Workspace 'my-workspace' has 2 rebuild jobs in the database
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result = runCLI('afc rebuild list my-workspace'); assert result.exit_code == 0; assert len(result.stdout) > 0; assert result.stderr == ''

test_cases.description: 'afc rebuild status <workspace-slug> <rebuild-id>' sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuilds/:id and prints job details including patch_results to stdout, exiting with code 0; exits non-zero if job not found.
preconditions: afc CLI is configured with a valid API endpoint and PAT
Workspace 'my-workspace' has a completed rebuild job with id 'job-uuid-1'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result = runCLI('afc rebuild status my-workspace job-uuid-1'); assert result.exit_code == 0; assert 'job-uuid-1' in result.stdout; assert 'completed' in result.stdout; result404 = runCLI('afc rebuild status my-workspace nonexistent-id'); assert result404.exit_code != 0

test_cases.description: 'afc rerere list <workspace-slug>' sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rerere and prints the list of recorded resolutions with path and recorded_at to stdout, exiting with code 0.

Workspace 'my-workspace' has 2 recorded rerere resolutions in rr-cache
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result = runCLI('afc rerere list my-workspace'); assert result.exit_code == 0; assert 'src/config.go' in result.stdout; assert result.stderr == ''

preconditions: afc CLI is configured with a valid API endpoint and PAT
Workspace 'my-workspace' has a recorded rerere resolution for 'src/config.go'
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result = runCLI('afc rerere forget my-workspace src/config.go'); assert result.exit_code == 0; assert result.stderr == ''; result404 = runCLI('afc rerere forget my-workspace nonexistent.go'); assert result404.exit_code != 0; assert result404.stderr != ''

test_cases.description: 'afc workspace patch-status <workspace-slug>' sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patch-status and prints workspace metadata, last_rebuild summary, per-patch status table, and summary counts to stdout, exiting with code 0.
preconditions: afc CLI is configured with a valid API endpoint and PAT
Workspace 'my-workspace' is in carry_patch mode with patches and a completed rebuild
test_cases.assertion_pseudocode: result = runCLI('afc workspace patch-status my-workspace'); assert result.exit_code == 0; assert 'my-workspace' in result.stdout; assert result.stderr == ''

property_tests.description: For any combination of active, conflict, merged_upstream, and disabled patches, a successful rebuild always produces an integration branch that equals the result of applying only active/conflict patches in position order onto upstream HEAD, with no influence from prior integration branch state.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate a carry_patch workspace with 0-10 patches randomly assigned statuses (active, conflict, merged_upstream, disabled) and random positions. Vary REBUILD_STRATEGY between 'rebase' and 'merge'. Use table-driven test cases in Go covering edge counts (0 active, 1 active, max active).
property_tests.invariant_check: After executeJob(rebuildJob) completes with status='completed': let expected = applyPatchesFromScratch(upstreamHeadSHA, activePatchesInPositionOrder, strategy); assert getRef(repoPath, integrationBranch) == expected.headSHA; assert result.patches_applied == len(activePatchesInPositionOrder); assert result.patches_skipped == len(skippedPatches)

property_tests.description: For any rebuild with N patches where patch K produces an unresolvable conflict, the rebuild halts after patch K, patches K+1 through N are not attempted, the integration branch ref is unchanged, and the temporary branch is deleted.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate a patch list of 2-8 patches. Randomly select one patch K (1 <= K <= N) to produce an unresolvable conflict. Use Go table-driven tests with K at positions 1, middle, and N.
property_tests.invariant_check: priorSHA = getRef(repoPath, integrationBranch); executeJob(rebuildJob); assert job.status == 'failed'; assert len(result.patch_results) == K; for i in range(K+1, N+1): assert patchAtPosition(i) not in result.patch_results; assert getRef(repoPath, integrationBranch) == priorSHA; assert tempBranchExists(repoPath) == false

property_tests.description: For any rebuild job enqueued with REBUILD_STRATEGY value S, the job executes with strategy S regardless of any subsequent changes to the REBUILD_STRATEGY workspace variable before the job runs.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Enqueue a rebuild job with strategy='rebase'. Before the job executes (while it is queued), update REBUILD_STRATEGY workspace variable to 'merge'. Then execute the job. Repeat with initial strategy='merge' and change to 'rebase'.
property_tests.invariant_check: job = enqueueRebuild(workspace, strategy='rebase'); updateWorkspaceVar(workspace, 'REBUILD_STRATEGY', 'merge'); executeJob(job); result = parseJobResult(job); assert result.strategy == 'rebase'; assert spy.mergeNoFFCalls == []; assert spy.cherryPickCalls != []

property_tests.description: For any workspace with one or more patches in merged_upstream status at the start of a rebuild, after a successful rebuild all merged_upstream patches are deleted from the patches_table and remaining positions are compacted to be contiguous starting from 1.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate a workspace with 1-5 active patches and 1-3 merged_upstream patches at arbitrary positions. Execute a successful rebuild. Vary the number and positions of merged_upstream patches.
property_tests.invariant_check: executeJob(rebuildJob); assert job.status == 'completed'; remainingPatches = listPatches(workspace); for p in remainingPatches: assert p.status != 'merged_upstream'; positions = sorted([p.position for p in remainingPatches]); assert positions == list(range(1, len(remainingPatches)+1))

property_tests.description: For any number of rebuilds that encounter the same conflict in the same patch, if rerere has a recorded resolution, each rebuild attempt resolves the conflict automatically and produces the same successful result.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Set up a patch that produces a deterministic conflict. Record a rerere resolution. Execute the rebuild 3-5 times (simulating repeated rebuilds). Use Go subtests to run N iterations.
property_tests.invariant_check: recordRerereResolution(conflict); for i in range(N): executeJob(rebuildJob); job = getJobByID(jobID); assert job.status == 'completed'; result = parseJobResult(job); assert result.integration_head_sha == expectedSHA; assert result.patches_applied == expectedCount

property_tests.description: For any patch P and two consecutive upstream fetches where upstream HEAD advances, if P was detected as merged_upstream at SHA1, it remains merged_upstream at SHA2 and is never reverted to active by a subsequent sync.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Set up a patch P that is an ancestor of upstream SHA1. Run sync at SHA1 (P transitions to merged_upstream). Advance upstream to SHA2. Run sync at SHA2. Use Go table-driven tests with different SHA advancement scenarios.
property_tests.invariant_check: sync1 = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync'); assert 'feature/P' in sync1.body.patches_merged; assert getPatch('feature/P').status == 'merged_upstream'; advanceUpstream(SHA2); sync2 = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync'); assert getPatch('feature/P').status == 'merged_upstream'; assert 'feature/P' not in sync2.body.patches_merged

property_tests.description: For any number of concurrent or sequential rebuild submission attempts for the same workspace_slug while a rebuild_job is already queued or running, exactly one rebuild_job is active at a time.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Submit 2-10 concurrent rebuild requests for the same workspace using Go goroutines. Also test sequential submissions while a job is queued. Use sync.WaitGroup to coordinate concurrent submissions.
property_tests.invariant_check: wg = sync.WaitGroup; results = make([]Response, N); for i in range(N): go func(i): results[i] = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuild'); wg.Done(); wg.Wait(); successCount = count(r for r in results if r.status == 202); conflictCount = count(r for r in results if r.status == 409); assert successCount == 1; assert conflictCount == N-1; assert len(listJobs('my-workspace', status='queued')) == 1

property_tests.description: For any GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/patch-status response, summary.total_patches equals len(patches) and the sum of all status counts equals total_patches.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Generate workspaces with 0-20 patches in random combinations of statuses (active, merged_upstream, conflict, disabled). Use Go table-driven tests with boundary cases (0 patches, all same status, all different statuses).
property_tests.invariant_check: resp = GET('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/patch-status'); s = resp.body.summary; assert s.total_patches == len(resp.body.patches); assert s.active + s.merged_upstream + s.conflict + s.disabled == s.total_patches; statusCounts = countByStatus(resp.body.patches); assert statusCounts['active'] == s.active; assert statusCounts['merged_upstream'] == s.merged_upstream; assert statusCounts['conflict'] == s.conflict; assert statusCounts['disabled'] == s.disabled

property_tests.description: For any rebuild execution that creates a temporary branch, regardless of outcome (success, conflict, or unexpected error), the temporary branch does not exist in the repository after the rebuild job terminates.
property_tests.for_any_strategy: Run rebuild jobs with three outcome scenarios: (1) all patches apply cleanly, (2) a conflict halts the rebuild, (3) an unexpected error (simulated panic/filesystem error) occurs mid-rebuild. Use Go subtests for each scenario.
property_tests.invariant_check: for scenario in [success, conflict, unexpected_error]: executeJob(rebuildJob, scenario=scenario); assert tempBranchExists(repoPath) == false; assert len(listBranches(repoPath, prefix='tmp-rebuild-')) == 0

edge_case_tests.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuild on a workspace in 'standard' mode returns HTTP 400 with a JSON error body and does not enqueue any job.
preconditions: SQLite database has a workspace 'standard-ws' with mode='standard'
Caller has 'rebuilds:write' permission scope

body.error: <message indicating workspace is not in carry_patch mode>

edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: jobsBefore = listJobs('standard-ws'); resp = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/standard-ws/rebuild'); assert resp.status == 400; assert resp.body.error != null; jobsAfter = listJobs('standard-ws'); assert len(jobsAfter) == len(jobsBefore)

edge_case_tests.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuild on a workspace that is not active or whose clone is not ready returns HTTP 400 with a JSON error body.
preconditions: SQLite database has a carry_patch workspace 'my-workspace' with status='archived' or clone_status='cloning'
Caller has 'rebuilds:write' permission scope

body.error: <message indicating workspace not active or clone not ready>

edge_case_tests.assertion_pseudocode: resp = POST('/api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuild'); assert resp.status == 400; assert resp.body.error != null; assert resp.body.error != ''

edge_case_tests.description: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/rebuild when no patches have status 'active' or 'conflict' returns HTTP 400 with a JSON error body.
preconditions: SQLite database has a carry_patch workspace 'my-workspace' that is active with a ready clone

smoke_tests.description: Full carry-patch end-to-end smoke test: operator checks patch status, triggers sync which detects merged patches and auto-enqueues rebuild, rebuild executes applying patches via rebase strategy, integration branch is updated, and final status check shows completed rebuild.
smoke_tests.trigger: Operator runs 'afc workspace patch-status my-workspace', then POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/sync, then waits for the rebuild job to complete, then runs 'afc workspace patch-status my-workspace' again.
expected_effects: Initial patch-status returns HTTP 200 with workspace_mode='carry_patch' and patches array
Sync returns HTTP 200 with patches_merged containing merged branch names and rebuild_triggered=true
Merged patches have status='merged_upstream' in the patches_table after sync
A rebuild job with type='rebuild' and status='queued' exists in the durable_job_queue after sync
Rebuild job completes with status='completed' and integration_head_sha updated in the database
Temporary branch does not exist in the repository after rebuild completes
merged_upstream patches are deleted from patches_table after successful rebuild
Remaining patch positions are contiguous starting from 1
Final patch-status returns HTTP 200 with last_rebuild.status='completed' and all active patches showing last_rebuild_result='success'

smoke_tests.description: Rebuild conflict smoke test: operator triggers rebuild which fails on a conflicting patch, inspects the failure, manually records a rerere resolution, re-triggers rebuild which succeeds via rerere replay.
smoke_tests.trigger: Operator sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuild, waits for failure, sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuilds/:id, records rerere resolution in the git repo, sends POST /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuild again.
real_components: git rerere (via git CLI in workspace repository)
expected_effects: First rebuild job returns HTTP 202 with status='queued'
First rebuild job completes with status='failed'
Conflicting patch has status='conflict' in patches_table with non-empty conflict_files
GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rebuilds/:id returns HTTP 200 with patch_results showing conflict
Temporary branch does not exist after first rebuild failure
Integration branch is unchanged after first rebuild failure
After rerere resolution is recorded in rr-cache, second rebuild job returns HTTP 202 with status='queued'
Second rebuild job completes with status='completed'
Integration branch is updated to new HEAD SHA after second rebuild
Temporary branch does not exist after second rebuild completes

smoke_tests.description: Rerere resolution management smoke test: operator lists recorded resolutions, identifies a stale one, deletes it via the forget endpoint, and confirms it is removed from the list.
smoke_tests.trigger: Operator sends GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere, then DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere/src/config.go, then GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere again.
expected_effects: First GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere returns HTTP 200 with resolutions array containing 'src/config.go'
DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere/src/config.go returns HTTP 204
'git rerere forget src/config.go' is executed in the workspace repository
rr-cache no longer contains the entry for 'src/config.go'
Second GET /api/v1/workspaces/my-workspace/rerere returns HTTP 200 with resolutions array not containing 'src/config.go'
